{{Infobox/Character |location = [[Wyld Woods]] |location_page_description = Unlocks the {{Item|Montezuma Pet}}. |x = -122 |y = 120 |z = 137 }} '''Sad Jacquelle''' is an [[NPC]] located in the {{zone|Wyld Woods}} who unlocks the {{Item|Montezuma Pet}}. == Interface == {{/UI}} == Dialogue == {| class="wikitable" !Condition !Dialogue |- | class="ct" | First Interaction |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: The Argofays have been so kind to welcome me in one of their huts. &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: It's been rough since I lost my &9cat&f. &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: It just left my sight! &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: I think it's playing around the &5Rift&f! &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: Please! &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: Please!! &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: Please!!! &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: Find my cat &9Montezuma&f! &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: Open my &6chest&f and take my &9Cat Detector&f! }} |- | rowspan="2" class="ct" | Opening chests inside her house |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: Not that chest! &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: That's where I store all the pictures of little Monte! }} |- |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: Uh... it's not that one either. &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: I was talking about the one behind me, silly! }} |- | class="ct" | Claiming [[Cat Detector]] |{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: Now please go and find my dear &9Montezuma&f!}} |- | class="ct" | Returning
{{DG|Found Montezuma}} |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: Hey you're back! &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: Did you find &9Montezuma&f? &eSelect an option: &a[I'm sorry but your cat is dead.] }} |- | class="ct" | Selecting {{Rmt|&a[I'm sorry but your cat is dead.]}} |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: ... &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: I know that! &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: I'm so glad you found him! &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: It's soul fractured into &99 parts&f when we crossed into the &5Rift&f. &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: I've been living in this cabin with 1\/9th of &9Montezuma&f for an eternity now. &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: Please! &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: Please!! &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: Please!!! &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: Find all parts of &9Montezuma&f's soul so I can enjoy a full cat again! &eYou unlocked the &9Montezuma &epet in your SkyBlock Menu! }} |- | class="ct" | Without All [[Montezuma]] Soul Pieces |{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: Have you found all of &9Montezuma&r's soul yet?}} |- | class="ct" | Found All [[Montezuma]] Soul Pieces |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: You found all the pieces of &9Montezuma&f's soul? &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: That's amazing! &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: I'll level with you now. &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: I'm still &9sad&f. &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: But it's because I'm stuck in an alternate reality... &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: With nowhere to go... &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: And nothing to do... &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: I can't sleep and yet I can't get out of bed. &e[NPC] &9Jacquelle&f: So how are you doing? }} |} == Trivia == Clicking on {{Rmt|&a[I'm sorry but your cat is dead.]}} plays a wither sound. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{history|2023/May 4|[[File:Sad Jacquelle.png|26px]] Added '''Sad Jacquelle'''.}} |beta= {{History|0.19|[[File:Sad Jacquelle.png|26px]] Added '''Sad Jacquelle'''.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Characters}}
